BiblicalUsage: Ziphion is a son of Gad, named among the sons of Jacob who went down into Egypt. In Genesis 46:16, Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Ziphion is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
